title: Marketplace SKU gating & trial provisioning checklist
content:
Purpose:
This is a compact, operational checklist + copy sketch for gating SKU access and provisioning free trials on cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP). The goal: reduce friction for SMB & midmarket customers while protecting entitlements and preserving agreed billing mapping.

Scope (what this doc covers):
- Mapping SKU -> Redwood product offering (hosted, dedicated trials, credits).
- Technical provisioning hooks (API/acceptance callback, webhook behavior).
- Trial entitlement gating: who can claim, quota limits, region exceptions.
- Minimum tile copy (elevator, benefits) + 3 short variants for marketplace tile/description.
- Acceptance & legal gates to satisfy security/compliance plus partner platform requirements.

One-line problem statement:
Marketplace trials are frequently mis-provisioned (wrong SKU, missing KMS metadata, mis-mapped billing) -> customer confusion and failed handoffs to CS. This checklist reduces common failure modes.

Quick notes / assumptions (stated):
- This is for self-serve trial activation via marketplace listing (no managed onboarding flow).
- Trials are time-limited credits (default 14 days / $500 equivalent) unless partner contract overrides.
- SKU gating means the marketplace's SKU must map to a Redwood product id and an entitlement object created in Redwood control plane.
- Security: do not provision data-plane access until KMS and SSO checks pass for enterprise SKUs.

Tile copy (3 short variants):
1) Elevator (concise):
   Redwood Inference — production-grade LLM inference. Fast, reliable, and cost-optimized. Try 14 days free.
2) Benefit-first (trial CTA visible):
   Run high-throughput LLM endpoints with built-in observability and cost controls. Start your free trial with $500 credits — instant provisioning via marketplace.
3) Tech-first (developer-targeted):
   Spin up dedicated capacity or hosted endpoints with SDKs and autoscaling. Includes sample workloads and CLI onboarding credits.

Micro-CTA examples (for tile/hero):
- "Start free trial — instant access"
- "Claim $500 credits and sample app"
- "Try hosted inference — no credit card"

SKU mapping checklist (operational):
- [ ] Confirm marketplace SKU canonical id and description (owner: Liam)
- [ ] Create internal SKU mapping ticket (GTM-4321) linking SKU -> product_id -> entitlement_template (owner: Aisha)
- [ ] Verify billing meter mapping (meter_id) and that usage will tag back to customer account (owner: Finance lead)
- [ ] Confirm region availability matrix for SKU (us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1) (owner: Renee)

Trial provisioning flow (technical hooks):
- Step 1: Marketplace sends purchase/acceptance webhook to our partner endpoint (POST /marketplace/accept) with order id and buyer info.
- Step 2: Redwood validates signature + currency and looks up SKU mapping, creates entitlement in control plane and issues trial credits.
- Step 3: Control plane responds to marketplace with success/failure webhook.
- Step 4: If entitlement created, automated welcome email + CLI token issued to buyer.
- Step 5: CS signal to attach onboarding runbook when usage > X tokens or support requested.

Technical acceptance items (dev/infrastructure):
- [ ] Partner endpoint implemented and deployed behind auth (path: /marketplace/accept) (owner: infra)
- [ ] Idempotency: repeated webhooks must be tolerant (detect duplicate order id) (owner: infra)
- [ ] Logging/tracing: include order_id, sku, account_id in traces for 30 days (owner: observability)
- [ ] Security: verify platform signatures and fail open only to a retry queue, never provision on signature failure (owner: security)
- [ ] Test harness: simulated webhook events + happy/unhappy paths in staging (owner: dev)

Entitlement gating rules (policy):
- Trial only if email domain is not on blocked list (blocklist maintained by Sales Ops).
- Only one trial per unique billing entity (detected by tax_id OR marketplace buyer id).
- Enterprise SKUs: do not auto-provision data-plane; create pending entitlement and alert AE/CS for manual kickoff.
- Geo exceptions: explicitly deny trial in regulated geos unless customer has signed DPA addendum.

Legal / compliance acceptance (must pass before public listing):
- [ ] Marketplace legal checklist completed (owner: legal)
- [ ] Privacy & DPA references included in tile and detail page (owner: legal)
- [ ] KMS + HSM requirements documented for enterprise SKUs (owner: security)

Onboarding artifacts to attach (automated on success):
- Short quickstart: CLI snippet, SDK sample, 3 example prompts (attach link to docs page)
- Trial runbook: 5 min smoke test instructions for customers and CS
- Contact: CS triage email + AE assignment logic (if contract value > threshold)

Edge cases & Known failure modes (notes to team):
- Marketplace sends V1 webhook but later changes schema -> versioning mismatch. Ensure schema version recorded on entitlement.
- Customer email mismatch between marketplace and control plane registration (manual merge flow needed).
- Trial claimed multiple times via different marketplaces -> dedupe by company tax id where present.

Open questions (to resolve before launch):
- Q1: default credit amount for each marketplace (AWS wants dollar SKU, Azure prefers trial period). Who finalizes amounts? (action: Finance + GTM)
- Q2: should trials auto-convert to pay-as-you-go after expiry or suspend API keys? Default: suspend and email 48hrs before expiry. (action: Product)
- Q3: what reporting fields do marketplaces require back (e.g., first-use timestamp)? (action: Liam to confirm)

Validation checklist (pre-launch):
- [ ] End-to-end staging test: marketplace -> webhook -> entitlement -> welcome email -> usable API key (owner: dev)
- [ ] Billing reconciliation test with Finance (owner: Finance)
- [ ] Copy QA across tile variants + localized strings for en-US, en-GB, fr-FR (owner: Localization)
- [ ] CS playbook reviewed and assigned (owner: CS)

Rollout plan (phased):
- Phase 0: internal beta with partners team and 10 customers (manual vetting)
- Phase 1: soft launch on one marketplace (AWS) with region us-east-1 only
- Phase 2: enable additional regions and marketplaces after 2 weeks of metrics (good first-use, <10% provisioning failures)

Metrics to watch (first 30 days):
- Provisioning success rate (target >98%)
- Time-to-first-call (median < 15 minutes)
- Trial-to-paid conversion (baseline expected 6–9%)
- Support tickets per trial activation (target < 0.15)

Ship checklist + final signoffs needed:
- [ ] Infra: endpoint live in prod + idempotency tested
- [ ] Security: signature verification and KMS guidance OK
- [ ] Legal: marketplace contract + DPA checked
- [ ] Finance: SKU meter mapping complete
- [ ] GTM: tile copy approved and localization queued

If anything here is unclear ping #marketplace-launch or drop comment in the linked ticket GTM-4321.

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Keep the onboarding copy short; marketplaces truncate quickly. Keep two-line elevator + 1 bullet benefit.
- Prioritize AWS launch first; re-use infra for Azure/GCP but expect schema differences.

Revision history:
- 2025-01-10 created by Aisha Kapoor (initial draft)
- 2025-01-22 added entitlement gating rules and tile copy variants (Renee)
- 2025-02-01 added tech acceptance items and linked PRs (Liam)

END
